wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 04-005 models the vanilla gamestate_t machine (GS_LEVEL=0/GS_INTERMISSION=1/GS_FINALE=2/GS_DEMOSCREEN=3 from doomstat.h), the 6 canonical gameaction-driven transitions (G_DoCompleted/G_DoWorldDone/F_StartFinale/D_StartTitle/G_DeferedInitNew), the D_Display screen-wipe rule (wipe = gamestate != wipegamestate), and re-exports the per-state primitives from the read-only frontEndSequence/intermission/finale modules. Pure barrel + frozen manifests + predicates, no source modification. Unblocked by the e365561 prereq-cycle fix (07-001 completed first).
